scope: Feature SESSION-INTEGRATION, change SUBMIT-001: follow developer clarification that Codex idle/inactivity clocks follow the last verified user-submitted prompt, not raw input. Preserve vertical wheel/no-button hover reading state while retaining draft/navigation/unknown safety. Prepare unreleased 0.2.4 local binary; no personal install/trust/session changes or publication.

acceptance.description: Diagnostic relay preserves installed argv/env/cwd and exact bytes without query injection or policy changes.
Diagnostic audit retains only bounded redacted categories/metadata, never prompts, typed characters or raw keycodes.
Diagnostic event ring and filtered owner state retain timestamped private troubleshooting evidence.
Diagnostic fixture performs no model calls or personal changes and cleans only owned processes.

Only verified real user prompt submission sets Codex userAt and renews idle/inactivity clocks, using native submission timestamp bound to exact owner/thread/turn/client ID. Keyboard, draft, mouse, focus, terminal reports, warm hooks/completions and unknown submissions cannot renew it.

Valid vertical SGR wheel and no-button hover preserve existing completed metric, generation, composition eligibility and submission timestamp during/after replies. They never restore eligibility invalidated by drafts/navigation/errors. Invalid or unsupported mouse forms remain conservative.

Draft typing/paste, keys and potentially mutating click/drag/navigation or unknown input still block/cancel unsafe dispatch without renewing submission clocks. Pending report parsing/expiry and final authorization retain input precedence and exact Buffer forwarding.
Recognized passive focus/terminal replies retain completed eligibility across chunk boundaries with bounded fail-closed unknown/expired handling.
Keep strict input>100000, Codex idle20min and four-hour budget since last real submitted prompt. Busy, compaction, disconnect, stale metrics and owner end skip; warm turns never renew the budget.
Native local owner preserves model/cwd/permission arguments and native resume without remote overrides or home overlay.
Actual timed marker/K delivery through exact owner queue and nonce continuity remains proven after wheel/hover events, never by terminal key injection or second conversation writer.
CLI and in-session resume preserve intended native thread/cwd and require fresh verified user submission/reply before warming.
Standalone 0.2.4 embeds updated decoder/owner, synchronized distinct version, and works through existing repair and actual packaged native E2E.
Preserve native hook trust/settings, recorded native executable and paths; existing owners require relaunch and personal installation is unapplied.
Unknown/conflicting owners and observer errors skip; exact warm client attribution and owned cleanup remain verified.
Native parser/permission semantics and unsupported pass-through remain unchanged.
Setup remains an install alias with ownership-safe selection.
Repair preserves owned standalone/source provider boundaries and restores supported missing entries.
Repair preserves custom settings and saved warm preference unless explicit --warm.
Repair reports effective readiness/restarts without bypassing global disables or native hook trust.
Same/newer update migration and operation lock sequencing remain verified.
Ownership conflicts fail before writes; late provider failures compensate prior state and activation.
Distinct synchronized immutable 0.2.4 runtime can be repaired without a build checkout or external Node on PATH.
Pre-code real owner PTY and actual native source/resume/packaged proofs retain repeatable artifacts, unchanged personal hashes and explicit synthetic/probe boundaries. No post-code unit tests.
